Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring benefit parity for ferry galley workers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to galley services on state ferries; and adding anew section to chapter 47.60 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.60 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The secretary shall adopt rules prescribing standards and criteriato assure that each Washington state ferry system contract entered intowith a private party or firm for vessel galley services must containspecific clauses requiring the following: (1) The contractor must provide for persons performing the servicesunder the contract health benefits that are similar to those providedto Washington state ferry system employees, but in no case are suchhealth benefits required to be greater than the benefits provided forbasic health care services under chapter 70.47 RCW. (2) The contractor must provide for persons performing the servicesunder the contract pension benefits that are similar to those providedto Washington state ferry system employees, but in no case are pension p. 1 HB 2888benefits required to be greater than the terms, benefits, andallowances under chapter 41.40 RCW.
